name: nightside
description: Capture the SHAPE of your agentic work in each project (hook events, tool names, counts, timings; never prompts, inputs, outputs or paths) as a WorkflowManifest you can preview byte for byte, and grow a Nightside planet from it with /planet. Nothing uploads unless you set a Nightside server and confirm a project's exact bytes. Also keeps a private local archive of your agent transcripts and a metadata-only agent ledger for graph-engineered programs.
